fixes.explanation: I get the guess, since the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab, across from Jericho (Numbers 35:1). But no valley gets named for the Levites. The LORD commands the Israelites to give cities for the Levites to live in, with pasturelands around them, from the inheritance they will possess (Numbers 35:2). One big valley would be easier to hand over, but that's not the order. It's cities, taken from the tribes' own land.

That's it, friend. When the killing was an accident, the assembly shields the manslayer from the avenger of blood (Numbers 35:25). Then the assembly brings him back to the city of refuge where he fled. He lives there until the death of the high priest.

Other way around, friend. The avenger is the one the assembly guards him from, not the one it gives him to (Numbers 35:25). After that, the assembly sends him back to the city of refuge he fled to. It's a safe place, not a handoff.
